   169→   268→  1217→  <p class="sec-body rev" data-i18n="community_body">Star FM 102.9 is not a corporate station. We are owned by, built for, and powered by the community of Klerksdorp and the Southern District. Every broadcast is an act of empowerment.</p>

   174→   273→  1222→      <div class="com-body" data-i18n="com1_body">We platform local leaders, entrepreneurs, educators, and activists — giving a microphone to the people making real change.</div>

   194→   293→  1242→      <div class="com-body" data-i18n="com5_body">A place where all community members — regardless of background — come to listen, learn and belong.</div>

   352→   451→  1400→// ── CURSOR (desktop only) ────────────────────────────────────────
   353→   452→  1401→if (window.matchMedia('(pointer: fine)').matches) {
   354→   453→  1402→  const cur = document.getElementById('cur');
   355→   454→  1403→  const curR = document.getElementById('cur-r');
   356→   455→  1404→  let mx=0,my=0,rx=0,ry=0;
   357→   456→  1405→  document.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
   358→   457→  1406→    mx = e.clientX; my = e.clientY;
   359→   458→  1407→    cur.style.left = mx+'px'; cur.style.top = my+'px';
   360→   459→  1408→  });
   361→   460→  1409→  (function loop(){ rx+=(mx-rx)*.1; ry+=(my-ry)*.1; curR.style.left=rx+'px'; curR.style.top=ry+'px'; requestAnimationFrame(loop); })();
   362→   461→  1410→}
   363→   462→  1411→
   364→   463→  1412→// ── NAV STUCK ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
   365→   464→  1413→const nav = document.getElementById('nav');
   366→   465→  1414→window.addEventListener('scroll', () => nav.classList.toggle('stuck', window.scrollY > 50), {passive:true});
   367→   466→  1415→
   368→   467→  1416→// ── DRAWER ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   369→   468→  1417→const drawer = document.getElementById('drawer');
   370→   469→  1418→const ham = document.getElementById('ham');
   371→   470→  1419→function toggleD() {
   372→   471→  1420→  const open = drawer.classList.toggle('open');
   373→   472→  1421→  ham.classList.toggle('open', open);
   374→   473→  1422→  ham.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
   375→   474→  1423→  document.body.style.overflow = open ? 'hidden' : '';
   376→   475→  1424→}
   377→   476→  1425→function closeD() {
   378→   477→  1426→  drawer.classList.remove('open');
   379→   478→  1427→  ham.classList.remove('open');
   380→   479→  1428→  ham.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
   381→   480→  1429→  document.body.style.overflow = '';
   382→   481→  1430→}
   383→   482→  1431→drawer.addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target === drawer) closeD(); });
   384→   483→  1432→document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeD(); });
   385→   484→  1433→
   386→   485→  1434→// ── SCROLL REVEAL ────────────────────────────────────────────────
   387→   486→  1435→const revObs = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
   388→   487→  1436→  entries.forEach(e => { if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('in'); revObs.unobserve(e.target); } });
   389→   488→  1437→}, { threshold: 0.08, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });
   390→   489→  1438→document.querySelectorAll('.rev').forEach(el => revObs.observe(el));
   391→   490→  1439→
   392→   491→  1440→// ── SHOW FEATURE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
   393→   492→  1441→function featureShow(row, title, body) {
   394→   493→  1442→  document.querySelectorAll('.show-row').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('on'));
   395→   494→  1443→  row.classList.add('on');
   396→   495→  1444→  document.getElementById('sf-title').innerHTML = 'Now Featured:<br>' + title;
   397→   496→  1445→  document.getElementById('sf-body').textContent = body;
   398→   497→  1446→}
